text:
Nora (Events): Locking registration copy for the evening "sunset" slot aimed at APAC. Need quick checklist: local time display, consent checkbox for recording + reuse, share-a-friend prefill.
Kai (Growth): We'll run a small paid test for the evening slot. Add utm params: utm_source={{source}}&utm_medium=webinar&utm_campaign=launchbench_q2. Also include referral_code param.
Priya (Growth): Add hidden field preferred_language so follow-ups can be localized later. Also push GA4 event on registration completion.
Diego (Ops): Zoom config: cloud recording ON, auto-transcribe ON, vendor captions preferred if creds arrive by Tue EOD. Retention 90 days. We'll produce SRT + plain transcript.txt next to clips in S3.
Mei (Sales Ops): Sales needs attendee CSV within 10 min after end. Fields: email, company, title, country, referral_code, utm_campaign, attended, watch_seconds, question_asked. If watch_seconds >= 600 OR question_asked==true -> mark MQL and route to Sales queue.
Rowan (Content): Post-event asset pack: master_edit.mp4, highlight_2m.mp4, cta_45s.mp4, full_transcript.txt, captions.srt, social_snippets.md (LI + X). Can Ops drop SRT and manifest file to s3://redwood/webinar-assets/{{event_id}}/?
Diego (Ops): Yes. Manifest will be a plain YAML file in S3 with clip names and timestamps, example lines:
manifest_version: 1
event_id: launchbench-2026-XX
clips: highlight_2m,cta_45s
master: s3://redwood/webinars/launchbench/master.mp4
srt: true
We won't nest JSON payloads in the manifest.
Nora (Events): Consent copy: "I consent to being recorded and to receiving follow-up materials from Redwood Inference." Legal already approved the template.
Priya (Growth): Lead routing: implement real-time webhook to POST /webhooks/webinar with HMAC header. Include idempotency key = event_id + email. Fallback to Zapier if hubspot webhook errors exceed threshold.
Mei (Sales Ops): HubSpot mapping list will be posted to the docs channel. Sales also wants a 20-min prep call 48 hours before. I'll schedule once registration passes 20.
Rowan (Content): I'll draft the follow-up email now: subject "Thanks — replay + highlights" body: 1 sentence, CTA buttons: Watch replay / Book demo / Download brief. Add UTM to each CTA.
CaptionBot: Vendor captions received and queued.
Diego (Ops): I'll drop the webhook test payload and S3 manifest link here in ~1 hour. If vendor creds missing by Tue EOD, fallback to Zoom auto captions and Zapier fallback for routing.
Nora (Events): Great. Action items: Diego - manifest + webhook; Rowan - asset captions + socials; Mei - HubSpot fields + sales prep; Kai/Priya - paid test + GA4. I'll push the registration live tonight and run an E2E test tomorrow 11am PT. Closing thread after successful test. :white_check_mark:
